prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant that we may profit by imitating them and be upheld by their prayer.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei-nos a graça de imitá-los para crescermos na fé e de sermos sustentados pela sua intercessão.

meta.face: Two clearly different men. Marcellinus (left, the priest): about fifty-five, a WIDE, LOW-BROWED face with broad, flat cheekbones and a rounded chin — a short, straight nose, small, warm, deep-set brown eyes with laughter lines, thick grey-flecked brows, a kindly mouth; grey-brown hair in a tonsure crown and a short, curly pepper-and-salt beard; a fatherly, calm look. Peter (right, the exorcist): about thirty, a NARROW, fine-boned face tapering to a pointed chin — a thin nose with a slight hook, large, dark, intense eyes under strong, straight black brows, a firm, closed mouth; short-cropped black hair and a short, sparse black beard along the jaw (short hair, not a Christ-like figure); an earnest, watchful gaze.
meta.basis: Damasus learned their story as a boy from their executioner: a priest and an exorcist beheaded under Diocletian and buried at the Two Laurels on the Via Labicana. A fresco in their catacomb shows them with short beards; the difference in age and face between the two is our choice.
